tasks.title: Timed Excel test (45 min)
howToSteps: Open a blank workbook and set a 45-minute timer before you look at the tasks.
Use a practice dataset of 200+ rows with dates, categories and amounts.
Complete tasks with lookup formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting and a chart.
Stop when the timer ends and list what you did not finish.
Redo the unfinished items without the timer and note which functions slowed you down.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as an Excel test interviewer. Give me 6 tasks I can finish in 45 minutes using a small sales dataset (lookups, pivot table, conditional formatting, one chart). After I answer, grade my approach and name the 3 functions I should review.

tasks.title: Home assignment – data analysis (SQL + Excel)
howToSteps: Pick an open dataset (for example a public sales or survey table) and write down 3 business questions.
Load it into a free database or spreadsheet and clean obvious problems (duplicates, blanks, wrong types).
Answer each question with a SQL query or an Excel pivot and keep the query text.
Summarize findings in half a page: question, method, result, recommendation.
Review the write-up as if you were the hiring manager and fix unclear parts.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a hiring manager for a Junior Data Analyst role. I will paste my short write-up and the SQL queries I used on a public dataset. Review correctness, clarity and whether my recommendation follows from the data. Give 3 strengths and 3 improvements.

tasks.title: Build a Power BI report from a public dataset
howToSteps: Choose a public dataset with at least two related tables.
Import and model the data: set relationships and create 3 measures.
Build a three-page report: overview, trend, drill-down, with consistent titles and filters.
Write 5 sentences on what a manager should do based on the report.
Export a screenshot set for your portfolio and note one thing you would improve.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a senior BI analyst. I built a Power BI report from a public dataset; here are the table names, measures and page titles: [paste]. Review the data model and the report design, and tell me what a PL-300 exam would expect that I missed.

tasks.title: STAR story bank (8 stories)
howToSteps: List 8 situations from work, study or volunteering: leadership, conflict, failure, influence, pressure, fast learning, process improvement, crisis.
Write each as Situation, Task, Action, Result in 4-6 sentences with one number in the result.
Rehearse each story aloud in under two minutes.
Mark which stories fit data topics (a messy dataset, a deadline, a stakeholder disagreement).
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as an interview coach. Here is one of my STAR stories: [paste]. Check that the Situation, Task, Action and Result are clear, the result has a measurable outcome, and it takes under two minutes to tell. Suggest edits.

tasks.title: Tableau Desktop Foundations exam prep
tasks.notes: Self-study review for the Tableau exam. The catalog lists the exam at roughly 25 hours including preparation; this plan assumes the visualization basics are already covered. Needs check: confirm the exam guide on the provider site.
howToSteps: Download the official exam guide and list each topic area.
Recreate one chart of each type (bar, line, map, dual axis) in Tableau Public or Desktop.
Practice calculated fields, filters, sets and a simple dashboard.
Take any free practice questions you can find and note weak topics.
Review weak topics once more the day before the exam.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a Tableau exam tutor. Quiz me with 10 multiple-choice questions on [topic area from the exam guide], one at a time, and explain each answer after I respond.

tasks.title: Case interview (Ops / Product)
howToSteps: Pick a case such as "orders dropped 15% last month, why?".
Structure your approach in 2 minutes: clarify, hypotheses, data needed, analysis.
Talk through it aloud, naming the metrics and charts you would use.
Record yourself and review pacing and structure.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as an interviewer giving a data analytics case. Start with a business problem, answer my clarifying questions, and then assess my structure, choice of metrics and conclusion. Keep your feedback to 5 bullets.

tasks.title: Mock behavioral interview
howToSteps: Ask a friend or use the prompt below to run a 45-minute behavioral interview.
Answer with your STAR stories, aiming for two minutes each.
Ask for feedback on clarity, confidence and any rambling.
Write down 3 changes for the next mock.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a hiring manager interviewing me for a Junior Data Analyst role. Ask 6 behavioral questions one at a time, wait for my answer, then give brief feedback. At the end summarize my strengths and the 3 most important improvements.

tasks.title: Mock interview in English
howToSteps: Run a full interview in English with a partner or the prompt below.
Cover self-introduction, a data project walk-through and technical questions.
Note unclear phrases and replace them with simpler wording.
Repeat the weakest answers once.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as an English-speaking interviewer for a Junior Data Analyst role. Ask me to introduce myself, walk through one data project, and answer two SQL questions. Give feedback on clarity, vocabulary and structure of my spoken answers.

tasks.title: Portfolio write-up: two projects with findings
howToSteps: Pick your best two pieces of work (the assignment and the Power BI report).
For each, write problem, data, method, result and lessons in one page.
Remove anything that is private or not licensed to share.
Ask one person to read it and tell you what is unclear.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a hiring manager reading my portfolio page for a Junior Data Analyst role. Here is the text: [paste]. Tell me in 5 bullets what is convincing, what is vague, and what numbers are missing.

PL-300 practice questions and revision
tasks.notes: Needs check: use only practice material you have confirmed is legitimate and free.
howToSteps: List the skill areas from the official PL-300 study guide.
Rate yourself 1-5 on each area and start with the lowest.
Redo the Power BI exercises for DAX, data modeling and row-level security.
Do timed sets of 20 questions and review every wrong answer.
On the last day, reread your notes on weak areas only.
tasks.promptTemplate: Act as a PL-300 exam coach. Ask me 10 scenario-based questions on [skill area], one at a time. After each answer, say whether it is right, explain why, and name the Microsoft Learn topic to review.
